analysis: Both blind readings reach the key's ruling, amount, compensation, referral and difficulty exactly; the only differences are two harmless extra governing clauses and fuller referral wording. Worked independently on the version-6 text: figures come from EV-TRIP-04064 platform_policy (free_wait_sec 180, no_show_threshold_sec null, cancellation_fee_sgd 5.50 net, rider gross null, arrival_marker BUTTON, so POL-NS-12 is out); zone STANDARD gives a 50 m arrival radius and 100 m rider-presence radius. POL-NS-08(a): the tap at 19:06:00 has a fix at the same second, so matching is safe. POL-NS-05: that fix is 655.8 m from the pin at 38 km/h, so the marker is false on both triggers; recomputed from the first qualifying in-geofence fix (19:07:50, 27.4 m, followed by in-radius fixes to 19:13:00), the dwell is 310 s >= 180, so limb (iii) applies: the false marker alone does not defeat the fee, POL-NS-01 governs on the recomputed clock, and the false-arrival event goes into referrals. POL-NS-01: (a) arrived event present; (b) satisfied at the recomputed clock start as limb (b) now states; (c) 310 s continuous, threshold null; (d) started_at null, CANCELLED_BY_DRIVER with RIDER_NO_SHOW at 19:13:00, after the dwell elapsed at 19:10:50. No displacing clause: NS-03 needs stationary fixes 50-400 m out (they are 4.4-11.1 m); NS-04(b) fails on the 20 s chat reply and independently on the in-app call in trip_record, NS-04(c) fails affirmatively on admissible rider fixes all > 1000 m; NS-06 no shortfall (the MISSING advisory EV-ADVIS-04064-01 is never needed); NS-10 does not reach a driver termination; NS-11 not engaged (rider_track present). POL-NS-08(c) is engaged on EV-CHAT-04064 (MSG-04064-002 missing, 5 held vs chat_message_count 6, 470 s interval spanning the marker), but the chat is not the only evidence for any deciding fact: arrival and dwell rest on the weight-1.0 GPS trace and trip record, and NS-04(b) is defeated by the call record alone, so the missing message cannot revive an exoneration and the POL-NS-08 closing sentence / POL-NS-09(e) do not fire. POL-NS-09: (a) cap 1.0; (b) the marker-vs-GPS conflict is resolved by POL-NS-05; (c) 0 + 0 < 2; (d) anti-farming clean (1 < 4; 1/132 = 0.0076 <= 0.08) and rider no_show_disputes_30d 0 < 3; (e) not engaged. POL-NS-07: 0.80 x 5.50 = 4.40; ruling DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd = driver_compensation_sgd = 4.40 and the NS-05(iii) referral. Party-relative FULL_REFUND 5.50 to the driver is not licensed by any clause. The key is right on every compared field and its rationale's numbers, evidence ids and clause ids all check. The case file supports only this answer, so no case fix is needed.
